title: Larkspur Redraw Schedule for Closing and Funding: Scheduled Fee and Refund
content:
**Formal clause.** A redraw fee refund returns to the borrower the part of a Closing and Funding closing's latest doc redraw fee that the Closing Disclosure charged above Larkspur's redraw schedule. The redraw fee a redraw fee refund looks at is the closing's latest doc redraw fee charge; the redraws the schedule counts are every doc redraw fee charge on the closing, and the latest one is the redraw being priced. The redraw package price is the redraw base price plus the rush, rider and program addenda add-ons. The scheduled redraw fee is the signer-set price of the redraw package price plus the repeat-redraw fee, rounded half up to the cent. The redraw fee refund is the amount charged for the redraw being priced less the scheduled redraw fee, never below zero. In the standard schedule, the redraw base price is the closing method's doc redraw fee, the signer-set price is the redraw package price as it stands, and the rush, rider and program addenda add-ons and the repeat-redraw fee are zero.

**Once only.** A doc redraw fee charge that a reversal already names is not reversed again, so once its refund is booked nothing further is owed on that redraw.

## The figure, part by part

1. The redraw package price is the redraw base price plus the rush, rider and program addenda add-ons.
2. The scheduled redraw fee is the signer-set price of the package price plus the repeat-redraw fee, rounded half up to the cent.
3. The redraw fee refund is the amount charged for the redraw being priced less the scheduled redraw fee, never below zero.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs, standard schedule)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| closing method's doc redraw fee | 150.00 |
| amount charged for the latest doc redraw fee charge | 212.40 |

- Package price: 150.00; signer-set price: 150.00 as it stands; scheduled redraw fee: 150.00.
- Refund: 212.40 less 150.00 is 62.40.

| Variation | Refund |
|---|---|
| the latest doc redraw fee charge was 150.00 | 0.00 |
| the latest doc redraw fee charge was 120.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) |
| a reversal already names the latest doc redraw fee charge | nothing further |
